set.body: The full reframe4s test gate is internally inconsistent: the immutable cce1817 pin lacks CanonicalArray referenced by ImageRepresentationPerformanceSuite, while current Ravel provides CanonicalArray but has renamed ArrayBuilder.update to writeLinear. Align the consumer calls and select one immutable Ravel revision, then rerun compileAll/testAll. This is independent of the locus4s extraction.
set.title: Align reframe4s consumers and pin with current Ravel API
